en: I'm Mr. Fuji. I look after Pokémon who have lost their trainers. Thank you for coming for me.
Please take this. It is a Poké Flute. Its tune will wake any Pokémon from even the deepest sleep.
There's a huge Pokémon asleep on the road, I hear. The flute should rouse it.
Has the Poké Flute been of use? Pokémon and people are happiest together, I always say.
